query:
SELECT
                max(s.provider_retry_at)
            FROM
                email_sync_streams s
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT
                    f.role
                FROM
                    email_mailbox_folders f
                WHERE
                    f.link_id = s.link_id
                    AND f.provider_id = s.scope_id
                    AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                LIMIT 1
            ) f ON true
            WHERE
                s.link_id = $1
                AND s.generation = $2
                AND s.provider = 'IMAP'
                AND s.provider_retry_at > now()
                AND (s.kind = 'folder_catalog' OR f.role = 'inbox')
